summary.text: Leo Jaramillo is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2021, representing District 5, which covers parts of Los Alamos, Rio Arriba, Sandoval and Santa Fe counties.
Jaramillo is vice chair of the Senate Rules Committee and also sits on the Senate Tax, Business and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Jaramillo's occupation as staff operations manager and a district office in Española.
Between sessions, Jaramillo chairs the Land Grant Committee.
